verdict.rationale: Extend's documentation names official SDKs in Python, TypeScript, Java, and Go. It shows `pip install extend-ai`, an SDK install step in the API quickstart, SDK polling helpers for async work, and agent guidance for writing SDK code. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality, and per-language reference depth beyond the overview.
